name: Dinadan
source:
Knight of the round who is beloved by Britannian citizens from Eiyuu Senki WWX.

Her reviews and opinions have a measurable impact on Britannia's economy.

"Mmh, bloody brilliant! This biscuit's got a marvelous texture; it just melts in yer mouth!"
